== Overview ==
It is enshrined in the southwestern part of Mishima City, northwest of the Matsumoto district, on the east bank of the Sakaigawa River, adjacent on the north to {{ill|Kuwado Shrine|ja|鍬戸神社|qid=Q134928574}} in the Nagabuse district.

Its founding is unknown, but it is identified with the {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} '''Takahashi Shrine''' (たかはしじんじゃ), and it is an old shrine also recorded in the ''{{ill|Izu no Kuni Shinkaichō|ja|伊豆国神階帳|qid=Q17193087}}'' as "Junior Fourth Rank Upper, Takahashi no Myōjin"<ref name="gen">[https://genbu.net/data/izu/takahasi_title.htm 高橋神社] - 玄松子</ref><ref name="engi">[http://engishiki.org/izu/bun/iz140205-01.html 高橋神社] - 延喜式神社の調査</ref>.
